name: dv-claude-dev-market
description: BarabashkaD's personal marketplace of Claude Code plugins/skills

plugins.name: python-venv-manager
plugins.description: Global Python environment manager for Claude skills. Creates and reuses one virtual environment per skill under a per-user Claude venvs directory, so environments persist across sessions and projects instead of being rebuilt every time. Works on Linux, macOS, and Windows.

plugins.name: tech-doc-to-markdown
plugins.description: Convert technical documentation (datasheets, reference and service manuals, schematics, standards, application notes) from PDF, scanned PDF, DjVu, DOC/DOCX, RTF, ODT, EPUB or page images into faithful, verified Markdown where tables, block diagrams, timing diagrams, bit fields, pinouts, register maps and dot patterns become text. Classifies the document first, then runs the transcription in a dedicated cold-context subagent, verifies it with self-check scripts and an adversarial fidelity review, and can split a long document into an index plus parts.

plugins.name: dv-freecad-harness-pitfalls
plugins.description: Companion reference for the cli-anything-freecad harness, recording the commands that return success while producing nothing. Covers sketch/pad, boolean rendering, DXF and SVG export, TechDraw, volume measurement, wires and spreadsheet aliases, each with the working alternative, plus the recipe-and-freecadcmd pipeline that does work.
